title: A Ghost for the Deadline
author: Petra Eriksen
blurb: Petra Halloran, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
